name: 证据门控的深度发现引擎
purpose: Separate semantic finding candidates from adopted findings and anchor findings by checking scope readiness, claim permission, design-result alignment, source evidence, counterexamples, competing explanations, robustness, and decision value.
eligibility_checks: support evidence is verified and inside the selected family

prediction, causal-effect, and decision-rule claims have a freshly recompiled plan, an allowed analysis layer, a trusted result adapter, hashed input provenance, a supported claim design, and exact honest-split, uncertainty, overlap, estimator, and sensitivity bindings when those methods are planned
assumptions: evidence roles and independence groups are reviewed before anchor eligibility is evaluated
human_gates: confirm competing explanations and robustness checks fit the route
outputs: completed result coverage by analytical layer
diagnostics: contract, evidence, counterexample, competing-explanation, robustness, and anchor-gate results
evidence_requirements: derived analysis_result evidence for advanced claims
completed and plan-bound analysis coverage evidence for every required substantive layer
allowed_claims: a bounded finding passed declared gates
an anchor finding is eligible to answer the core question
an advanced claim is confined to its compiled target, method, assumptions, and supported result evidence
forbidden_claims: an adopted angle answers the core question
a ready analysis plan is itself a validated effect
